p: Whytescauseway runs just off the High Street in Kirkcaldy, so this Admiral is in the thick of the town centre. It's an adult gaming centre, 18+ only.

Kirkcaldy is known as the Lang Toun thanks to its long main street running beside the Firth of Forth, and the Esplanade makes a good blowy walk with views across the water. Kirkcaldy Galleries, near the station, holds a strong collection of Scottish art alongside the town museum. Beveridge Park is a big Victorian park with a boating pond, and Ravenscraig Castle's ruins sit on the cliffs at the east end of town. Kirkcaldy is also the birthplace of economist Adam Smith. In April the Links Market fair takes over the prom, a long-standing tradition locals look forward to every year.
